# Recommended GitHub repository topics

These are the discoverability topics used as the project's target metadata:

- xiaomi
- xiaomi-vacuum
- robot-vacuum
- mi-home
- smart-home
- home-automation
- windows
- python
- desktop-app
- vacuum-map
- xiaomi-e10
- b112

The release workflow attempts to synchronize these topics when the GitHub token has repository-administration permission. The build does not fail if GitHub denies that optional metadata update.
